title: urnetwork / sim-latency automation
description: Internal v2 control-plane health. Reward receipt is not a chain settlement or a source approval. No candidate identities or embargoed scores are queried.

panels.title: epoch closing requires support
panels.description: A review deadline, unavailable reviewer, or winner build/publication/qualification failure blocks progression. Never approve automatically or substitute another source. Escalate to support@ur.xyz.

panels.title: sealed, awaiting publication
panels.description: Frozen reveal time still protects these sealed inventories. This is not an early leaderboard.

panels.title: reward events awaiting receipt
panels.description: Only published events count. A receipt acknowledges integration delivery, not irreversible payment, honesty approval, or safe source.

panels.title: oldest unacknowledged reward event
panels.description: Warn after five minutes. Reconcile the cursor feed and idempotent receipt before retrying; never create a replacement election to retry delivery.

panels.title: source activation intents pending
panels.description: Source approval and exact readiness receipts are required independently of provisional reward selection. Pending intents are not an active incumbent.

panels.title: supervisor durable heartbeat age
panels.description: Latest supervisor lease heartbeat; -1 means none registered. Warn above 30 seconds only while a supervisor is expected. The supervisor exits after the sixth seal. A stale lease cannot authorize source activation.

panels.title: independent capability holds
panels.description: A hold pauses only the named capability. Finalization blocks new seals and first elections while intake/grading continue; existing seals retain their authorized publication times. Incident safety holds need independently authorized recovery. Accepted evidence remains intact.

panels.title: retained integrity incidents
panels.description: Historical incidents in this scope, not a count of dishonest miners. Invalidation does not rewrite measurements or turn an infrastructure trust failure into no improvement.

panels.title: executor slots occupied
panels.description: Coordinator database custody per frozen executor. A terminal timeout may release this row before remote cleanup is confirmed; the separate physical admission observation must also allow reuse. A transport failure is not a new attempt.

panels.title: executor no-op admission receipts
panels.description: Every approved host must retain a passing no-op receipt against the same immutable round baseline before any candidate is dispatched. The five-percent operational screen is not proof of statistical equivalence.

panels.title: executor absolute budget remaining
panels.description: The original three-hour clock includes dispatch, reconnects, result transfer and archival verification. Recovery never grants another clock. Zero means idle or expired.

panels.title: executor host heartbeat age
panels.description: Coordinator-retained authenticated host heartbeat age. Minus one is a missing observation, shown in red rather than healthy; healthy sibling executors continue while an unavailable host is reconciled.

panels.title: executor transport reconciliation failures
panels.description: Failed authenticated agent operations over the last hour. These retain the same run identity; they do not count as candidate failures or authorize duplicate execution.

panels.title: executor state and expired custody
panels.description: Authenticated run state: 0 unknown, 1 accepted, 2 running, 3 succeeded, 4 failed. Expired custody requires reconciliation of the original run before slot reuse; closing waits for every admitted job.

panels.title: executor physical admission observation
panels.description: Signed current physical custody, separate from database slot state and historical no-op admission. One is available, zero occupied, minus one unknown or older than 60 seconds. Current policy host membership is required. This is an observation, not a lease or permission to repeat a run.

targets.expr: min by (executor_host) (((urnetwork_competition_executor_physical_available{env="$env"} * ((time() - urnetwork_competition_executor_physical_observed_at_seconds{env="$env"}) <= bool 60)) - ((time() - urnetwork_competition_executor_physical_observed_at_seconds{env="$env"}) > bool 60)) and on (executor_host) urnetwork_competition_executor_noop_qualified{env="$env"})
